fields.label: Main Issue Link
fields.description: The Feature Brief issue number or URL.

fields.label: Context / Links
fields.description: Exact sections of the Feature Brief plus the project guardrails that apply.

fields.label: Affected Paths (Scope Gate)
fields.description: Paths that may be modified versus read for context only. Ask before going outside Modify.

fields.label: Files / Symbols to Touch (Authoritative)
fields.description: Every file with an action, plus the symbols to add or change. Ask before exceeding this list.

fields.label: Contracts to Honor
fields.description: Type names, error semantics, pagination, authorization expectations taken from the Feature Brief.

fields.label: Technical Details
fields.description: Hard constraints and intentional side effects.

fields.label: Observability Hooks
fields.description: Logging, metrics, and tracing to add or update. No sensitive data.

fields.label: Depends On / Blocks
fields.description: Sub-issues that must precede this one or that it unblocks.

fields.label: Test Data & Verification Steps
fields.description: Fixtures, exact commands, and expected results.

fields.label: Expected Diff Size
options: Large (> 200 lines; requires prior plan approval)

fields.label: PR Boundaries
fields.description: What the pull request will and will not contain.

fields.label: Security / Privacy Checks
fields.description: Acknowledge the critical guardrails for this change.

fields.label: Roll-forward Nature
fields.description: Clarifies whether rollback planning is required.

fields.label: Tests & Validation
fields.description: What must be covered and how success is verified.
